value.message: Halton Hills Public Library's Acton branch runs Kids & Me, a free drop-in for babies up to age 6, Thursdays 1 to 2:30, no registration - Halton Region's site says, and I could not get into their page today. Links2Care's EarlyON centres in Acton and Georgetown are free for birth to 6, but I could not pin down their days or times.
